product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace experience platform for organizations to connect employees and manage intranets, digital signage, room and desk reservations, and visitors.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog covers workplace strategy, product features and marketing; technical implementation guides and release notes appear in the knowledge community, not a qualifying engineering blog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current job board has no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. AI-related responsibilities in security, product and marketing roles do not qualify.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure AI and Google Vertex AI; Bring Your Own Model supports Microsoft Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry and Google Gemini.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is a publicly claimed compliance framework, not a certification. SOC 2 is an attestation.

last_funding.notes: Most recent publicly identified round: Accel-KKR investment announced September 21, 2023. Amount was not publicly disclosed; amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest publicly identified investment predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Business Development Representative opening, United Kingdom remote.

launched_6mo.notes: Bring Your Own Model launched June 16, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: March 19, 2026 announcement: Eric Daggett joined as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward as Chief Technology Officer; Steve Terp retired.
